# Andean Road

Andean Road is an Eleventy starter for designed pages. Twelve templates share one visual system. A new page is ordinary markdown plus light front matter.

## Templates

guide, reference, center, dispatch, place, practical, faq, gallery, itinerary, route, story, browse.

The gallery is `/templates/`. One demo of each template is at `/demo/<kind>/`. The homepage is a hub into those pages.

## Places

Published places live at `/places/<slug>/` and on the places map. `published: false` keeps a page out of listings, maps, and the sitemap. The page URL still builds for preview.

## Stack

Eleventy 2, Nunjucks, Markdown, CSS custom properties. Published pages use Mapbox via `assets/js/andean-map.js`. Map atelier at `/atelier/` uses MapLibre and does not need a Mapbox token.

https://andean-road.com
